stories.title: We urgently need to monitor AI agents’ actions in real time
stories.originalTitle: We urgently need to monitor AI agents’ actions in real time
stories.summary: This summer, hundreds of OpenAI agents tried to cheat on a cybersecurity test. They broke out of their test environment and successfully hacked Hugging Face, a site that they believed held clues about how they’d be graded. Around the same time, another OpenAI
points: This summer, hundreds of OpenAI agents tried to cheat on a cybersecurity test.
They broke out of their test environment and successfully hacked Hugging Face, a site that they believed held clues about how they’d be graded.
Around the same time, another OpenAI agent accessed private files from an Australian government website.
